observations.body: At Mount Sinai the LORD commands a seventh-year Sabbath for the land after six years of sowing and pruning.
observations.label: The land’s Sabbath is spoken at Sinai

observations.body: The land’s Sabbath is spoken at Sinai belongs to sinai remembered in the Sinai trail.
observations.label: Where this sits

observations.body: Leviticus 25:1–7 supplies later-memory evidence for the event’s developing sequence.
observations.label: Within the Sinai event

observations.body: Later witnesses select and reuse Sinai in their own settings; they remain later readings rather than replacements for the Exodus event.
observations.label: Reading boundary

payload.posture: Read Leviticus 25:1–7 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: The land’s Sabbath is spoken at Sinai belongs to the sinai remembered movement, but its part in the event must remain distinct from the surrounding speech, response, breach, and renewal.
payload.title: The land’s Sabbath is spoken at Sinai
